messages.message: Replace the v0.2 reliability claim with the v0.3 fail-closed gate. Full shuffle is rejected as a default; circular shift is one assumption-bound diagnostic only. Preserve all null disagreements and low-power states as UNKNOWN.

Add receipt fields for independence unit, episode/seed/context IDs, candidate search count, split membership, estimator/null family, invariance assumptions, intervention match set and gate states. Do not introduce a composite emergence scalar.

Persist the complete selection-to-provenance-reentry chain. Decodability, broadcast and structural ignition remain proxies until receiver-specific causal use is shown by matched lesion/rescue and truthful/shuffled/no-reentry contrasts.

Drive the H1 replay adapter with frozen matched episodes, excluded-variable/alternative-path interventions, registered-target attestation and untouched outcome folds. Work-event creation or local component tests are not target execution.
Register H-UDB-EM-008 through H-GWT-UDB-013 with their counterhypotheses. Treat estimator/null disagreement, hidden-context risk and low power as retained negative knowledge.
Bind every causal edge candidate and intervention to source_epoch, graph_epoch, state hash, conditioning set and alternative-path tests. Endpoint concordance alone cannot activate a causal edge.
Any n-ary synergy use must preserve the complete source set and estimator/axiom identity; overlapping pairwise atoms cannot be summed. Material estimator disagreement yields UNKNOWN.
No live FRANK emergence or GWT claim is promoted. Require a registered Andreas Ubuntu receipt set and keep local/hosted proxy evidence separate from target evidence.

The v0.3 research result does not resolve current BASE/WP02/WP13 parser and target-runner blockers. It only supplies future scientific receipt requirements; do not reinterpret work events or patch plans as execution passes.
